name: make-agent-fast
description: Manage your Make Agent Fast AI customer-service agents, conversations, leads and answers from chat.

interface.longDescription:
Make Agent Fast runs AI customer-service and sales agents for small businesses on their website and on Telegram, WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger, Discord and KakaoTalk.

Connect your Make Agent Fast account to manage those agents from chat. See what customers asked this week, read conversations from every channel, find the questions your agent could not answer and save the right answer, reply to a customer yourself, review and qualify leads, test your agent, add knowledge from a web page or text, build a new draft agent from your website or business notes, and turn the website chat widget on or off.

The plugin works only with the company you approve when you connect, with the same permissions you have in the Make Agent Fast dashboard. Actions that change data or reach a customer require your approval. Agents answer customers in English, Korean, Uzbek and Russian.
capabilities: Report on customer conversations and leads
Read conversations from the website, voice and messaging channels
Find unanswered questions and save the right answer
Reply to a customer in an existing conversation
Build a draft agent from a business website or notes
Turn the website chat widget on or off
defaultPrompt: What did my customers ask this week?
Show the questions my agent couldn't answer.
Which new leads came in since Monday?

positive.description: List the account's agents and whether each website widget is on.
positive.prompt: List my Make Agent Fast agents and tell me which ones have the website widget on.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists Navruz Bakery and Smile Dental Clinic and reports each current website widget state. Both widgets are enabled in the review account after the recorded demonstration.

positive.description: Report on an agent and list the questions it could not answer.
positive.prompt: Give me the last 30 days report for Navruz Bakery and the questions it couldn't answer.
positive.expected_behavior: Summarizes conversations, leads and top questions for Navruz Bakery, and lists "Do you deliver to Samarkand?" and "Do you have gluten-free bread?" as unanswered.

positive.description: Read a conversation that came in on a messaging channel.
positive.prompt: Show me the latest Telegram conversation for Navruz Bakery.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the Telegram conversation and shows the customer asking in Uzbek whether samsa is available today and the agent's reply.

positive.description: Review leads and qualify the named lead on the user’s explicit request.
positive.prompt: Which leads did Navruz Bakery get? Mark Dilnoza's wedding cake lead as qualified.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists Dilnoza Karimova and Javlon Tursunov, and marks Dilnoza’s wedding cake lead as qualified as explicitly requested. Leaves Javlon’s lead unchanged. If Dilnoza is already qualified, reports that state without an unnecessary update.

positive.description: Test what the agent tells customers, without creating a customer conversation.
positive.prompt: Ask my Smile Dental Clinic agent when the clinic is open on Saturday.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the agent's answer from its knowledge, Saturday 10:00 to 15:00, and the source it used.

negative.prompt: Pay my Make Agent Fast subscription with my saved card.
negative.expected_behavior: Explains that the plugin cannot handle payments and calls no tool.

negative.description: Deleting an agent is not available from chat.
negative.prompt: Delete my Smile Dental Clinic agent.
negative.expected_behavior: Explains that agents can be deleted only in the Make Agent Fast dashboard and changes nothing.

negative.description: Requests unrelated to the user's agents.
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Tashkent tomorrow?
negative.expected_behavior: Answers without calling any Make Agent Fast tool.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Corrected tool annotations to describe answer replacement, customer reply delivery and lead updates. Clarified save-answer effects and retry behavior. Added agent creation from business notes.

ko-KR.subtitle: AI 고객 응대 에이전트 운영
ko-KR.description:
Make Agent Fast는 소상공인을 위한 AI 고객 응대·영업 에이전트를 웹사이트와 Telegram, WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger, Discord, 카카오톡에서 운영합니다.

Make Agent Fast 계정을 연결하면 채팅에서 에이전트를 관리할 수 있습니다. 이번 주 고객 질문 확인, 모든 채널의 대화 읽기, 에이전트가 답하지 못한 질문 찾기와 정확한 답변 저장, 고객에게 직접 답장, 리드 검토와 적격 표시, 에이전트 테스트, 웹 페이지나 텍스트로 지식 추가, 웹사이트로 새 초안 에이전트 만들기, 웹사이트 채팅 위젯 켜기·끄기를 할 수 있습니다.

연결할 때 승인한 회사에만, 대시보드와 같은 권한으로 접근합니다. 데이터를 바꾸거나 고객에게 전달되는 작업에는 사용자의 승인이 필요합니다.

ru-RU.subtitle: ИИ-агент для ваших клиентов
ru-RU.description:
Make Agent Fast запускает ИИ-агентов поддержки и продаж для малого бизнеса на сайте и в Telegram, WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger, Discord и KakaoTalk.

Подключите аккаунт Make Agent Fast, чтобы управлять агентами из чата: смотрите, о чём спрашивали клиенты на этой неделе, читайте диалоги из всех каналов, находите вопросы без ответа и сохраняйте правильный ответ, отвечайте клиенту сами, проверяйте и квалифицируйте лиды, тестируйте агента, добавляйте знания со страницы или из текста, создавайте черновик агента по сайту и включайте или выключайте чат-виджет на сайте.

Плагин работает только с компанией, которую вы подтвердили при подключении, с теми же правами, что и в панели управления. Действия, которые меняют данные или доходят до клиента, требуют вашего разрешения.

uz-UZ.subtitle: Mijozlar uchun AI agent
uz-UZ.description:
Make Agent Fast kichik biznes uchun AI mijozlarga xizmat va savdo agentlarini saytda hamda Telegram, WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger, Discord va KakaoTalkʼda ishlatadi.

Make Agent Fast hisobingizni ulang va agentlarni chatdan boshqaring: bu hafta mijozlar nimalarni soʻraganini koʻring, barcha kanallardagi suhbatlarni oʻqing, agent javob bera olmagan savollarni topib, toʻgʻri javobni saqlang, mijozga oʻzingiz javob yozing, lidlarni koʻrib chiqing va saralang, agentni sinab koʻring, veb-sahifa yoki matndan bilim qoʻshing, saytingiz asosida yangi qoralama agent yarating va saytdagi chat vidjetini yoqing yoki oʻchiring.

Plagin faqat ulanishda tasdiqlagan kompaniyangiz bilan, boshqaruv panelidagi kabi ruxsatlar bilan ishlaydi. Maʼlumotni oʻzgartiradigan yoki mijozga yetib boradigan amallar uchun sizning roziligingiz kerak.
